meta.title: Pricing: Websites, Product Design, UX Audit & Coaching | Viesigners
meta.description: Viesigners pricing: "from" prices for websites and landing pages, fractional product design (from US$3,450/month), the fixed-price UX/CRO audit and ImpaX business coaching.

sections.lead: Every service has a starting price. Your final quote depends on the scope, and we confirm it in writing before any work begins.

tabs.label: Websites & landing pages
tabs.title: Websites, landing pages and *sales funnels*
tabs.lead: A fixed price per project, set after a short call about your goals, the number of pages and the features.
items: Fast development and basic SEO/GEO setup

tabs.label: Product & app design
tabs.title: Product design for *SaaS, apps and AI products*

plans.p: A product designer, lead or head of design from 5 hours a week. The hourly rate drops as hours increase.
A defined scope: a new product, a redesign or a feature, with a fixed price and timeline. Ask about our accelerated overhaul with two senior designers in parallel.

tabs.label: UX/CRO audit
tabs.title: Fixed-price *UX/CRO audit*
tabs.lead: The best first step: find out what costs you customers before you redesign or spend more on ads.
items: Review of message, user experience, conversion path, trust and mobile
Prioritized action plan with annotated screens

tabs.label: Business coaching
tabs.title: ImpaX *business coaching* program
tabs.lead: Our ImpaX program helps coaches, consultants and experts build a premium offer and sign clients. The program currently runs in French; an English cohort opens when the waitlist is full enough.

items: Up to two 1-hour Q&A sessions a week

tabs.note: Programs last 6 to 13 weeks, with weekly, 3-month and annual options. Longer commitments get a discount, and you can upgrade within a set period at no fee. Prices before taxes.

currency.note: Converted prices are approximate, rounded down.

sections.p: Tell us where you are and what you want to achieve. We'll point you to the right option and confirm the price.

faq.q: Why do you show your prices?
a: Because it saves everyone time. You know before the first call whether we fit your budget, and we spend the call on your project instead of on numbers.
They are starting prices. Your final price depends on the scope, and we confirm it in writing before any work begins. There are no surprise fees.

faq.q: In which currency do you bill?
a: Our prices are set in US dollars. The currency selector shows an approximate equivalent in Canadian dollars or euros; your final quote confirms the billing currency. Prices are before taxes.

faq.q: Where should I start if I'm not sure what I need?
a: With the UX/CRO audit. It shows what costs you customers and which service would fix it, and you can act on it with or without us.
